create_layoutlmv2_processor: create a LayoutLMv2Processor instance with an image processor and tokenizer for document layout analysis
call_processor_with_images: call the LayoutLMv2Processor with images, text, bounding boxes, and word labels to produce encoded model inputs
call_processor_with_ocr: call the LayoutLMv2Processor with images and text when apply_ocr is enabled to auto-extract words and bounding boxes
get_overflowing_images: get overflowing images from the LayoutLMv2Processor when truncation produces overflowed token samples
get_model_input_names: get the model input names from the LayoutLMv2Processor property returning input_ids, bbox, token_type_ids, attention_mask, and image
